motivation: Test an additional general embedding architecture with causal attention and explicit last-real-token pooling. The already-installed Qwen embedding weights are not an agent-planning API and are used solely to obtain numeric representations. No generative outputs or task-specific instructions. Preserve compatibility with all prior tools.
installation: Use Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B at author revision 97b0c614be4d77ee51c0cef4e5f07c00f9eb65b3. Verify the public LFS or git object identity against local files. Learn normalization, max input length, padding and last-token pooling from declarative metadata. Never enable arbitrary repository code. Keep the new directory separate from the three-encoder experiment.
efficiency: Before full training-only vector computation, time a deterministic 96-text sample. If CPU projection exceeds one hour, first run a deterministic internal subset with a proportional baseline. Use already warmed caches for unchanged encoders. This is unsupervised computation, logged separately from classifier fits.
test: Through the ordinary unified entry give just one full asset directory and numeric limits, at most 28 actual fits including final refit. Do not specify a winning member, combination or policy mode. Compare with the previous same-budget autonomous run on identical task data. Count separately any supervised acceptance test. If the new option is passed over, one individually labelled engineering probe may compare its own classifier to the training primary reference, but cannot stand in for autonomous selection. Only a sealed clean-process prediction may be evaluated externally.
